project.name: IKE Dashboard Download
project.description: Maven repository access with the JDK alone: Nexus search, version resolution from maven-metadata.xml, settings.xml proxies and servers, platform trust, and the resumable download and unpack of a classified artifact through the local repository. Copied from Komet's artifact-resolution module (ikmdev/komet, Apache 2.0) and freed of its Komet and Tinkar dependencies.
